title: Letter 1
text: Hello love, I wish I had started this when you first left but I got this idea right now so here we are. I love you so deeply and hope you're having so much fun in texas.

title: Letter 2
text: Hello love, HAPPY 6 MONTH MEETIVERSARY. Who knew that day would be the best domino effect of all time. title: Letter 5

title: Letter 6
text: Hello love, HAPPY 4 MONTH ANNIVERSARY YAYYYYY. The last 4 months have been the best 4 months of my life. You've shown me how wonderful it is to be loved by somebody else. You're the girl I wanna share every aspect of my life with and I just want you to know how special you are to me. Love you rif!
